  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MARCH 29, 2022

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Himmelrich at 5:34 p.m.,
  on Tuesday, March 29, 2022, via teleconference pursuant to Assembly Bill No. 361 signed by, Governor
  Gavin Newsome at https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/uheduqhq.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Sue Himmelrich
  Mayor Pro Tem Kristin McCowan (arrived at 5:43 p.m.)
  Councilmember Phil Brock
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Lana Negrete (arrived at 5:46 p.m.)
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Christine Parra

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  Interim City Attorney Joseph Lawrence
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:34 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Negrete and Mayor Pro Tem
  McCowan.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no public comment on closed sessions.
  Mayor Pro Tem McCowan
  joined at 5:43 p.m.  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:36 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 6:14 p.m., with all members present, except
  Councilmember Negrete  Councilmember de la Torre, to report the following:
  joined at 5:46 p.m.
  1.A. Public Employee Appointment:
  Title – City Attorney
  Councilmember de la Torre
  excused at 6:13 p.m.  The Mayor advised this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 6:15 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Sue Himmelrich
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  March 29, 2022
